name: REEID Builder Integrity
author: REEID GCE

sections.description:
REEID Builder Integrity scans WordPress content for structural inconsistencies,
editor signals, Gutenberg block faults, and supported page-builder state.

The initial supported editor and builder families are:

  • WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg)
  • Classic and other non-block content
  • Elementor
  • SiteOrigin Page Builder

REEID Builder Integrity is diagnostic-only. Scanning, classification, technical
signals, and source evidence are read-only. The plugin does not modify stored
content or provide an alternative content editor.

When an issue is detected, you can review the diagnostic evidence and open the
record in the normal WordPress editor in a new tab to make corrections using
the site’s existing editing workflow.

The plugin does not send site content to external services.

Third-Party Libraries

REEID Builder Integrity includes bundled portions of Monaco Editor 0.56.0,
licensed under the MIT License.

Project: https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor

licenses/monaco-editor-LICENSE.txt for details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the reeid-builder-integrity directory to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate REEID Builder Integrity through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Tools > REEID Builder Integrity in the WordPress admin.
sections.faq:
Does REEID Builder Integrity modify site content?

No. REEID Builder Integrity is read-only. It scans, classifies, and displays
diagnostic evidence without modifying stored content.

How do I correct a detected issue?

Review the diagnostic findings, then open the affected record in the normal
WordPress editor. Corrections are made through WordPress or the page builder
already used by the site.

Does REEID Builder Integrity send content to an external service?

No. REEID Builder Integrity does not send site content to external services.
sections.changelog:
0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added Gutenberg, Classic, Elementor, and SiteOrigin detection.
  • Added bounded site diagnostics and WP-CLI scanning.
  • Added conservative malformed Gutenberg structure detection.
  • Added read-only single-record diagnostic evidence and native editor handoff.

screenshots.caption: Site-wide diagnostics — Scan published WordPress content in bounded batches and identify editor or builder integrity issues without modifying content.
Single record diagnostics — Inspect one WordPress post, page, or supported record in detail, including likely editor, integrity state, technical signals, and native editor handoff.
Source evidence — Review the stored content and builder signals behind a detected integrity issue, including mixed-builder evidence, without modifying stored content.
